Name: Separate Elevator Progression
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
This mod alters the mine elevator in multiplayer so that it uses your own personal record for the deepest level reached, rather than all progress being shared between all players. If your friend makes it to Floor 120 but you've not gone deeper than Floor 20, the elevator will only let you go down as far as Floor 20.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/963]Skull Cavern Elevator[/url].

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Fixed: Elevator menu not resetting the floors it shows after COMPLETING the "Danger in the Deep" challenge.
